verdict.rationale: Termius is an SSH/terminal client, not a VPN or mesh-networking product, so subnet routing is outside its product category. Its docs say it connects "without the internet, a proxy, or VPN." Its jump hosts and SSH port forwarding are related SSH features, not subnet routers, and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use subnet routers to reach devices outside my local network as if I were on it
